response.sql: WITH acc_avg AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM acc_avg) SELECT a.account_id, a.avg_amount, a.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess FROM acc_avg a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
